664:t_1:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「All the preparations are complete...」

664:t_1:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, let us begin... a feast of vengeance in this closed universe.」

664:t_1:7.en:
???
(As I thought, you... will not forgive us...)

664:t_2:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I'm so glad. The fleet is safe, too.」

664:t_2:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$ランカ$$... There's no telling what will happen now. Go to $$アイランド１$$, like $$シェリル$$.」

664:t_2:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
「But some people might be frightened if this little one comes with me, so...」

664:t_2:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「So it's a $$バジュラ$$ larva separated from its swarm...」

664:t_2:8.en:
$$ランカ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ came to understand us... That's why I want to protect this little one.」

664:t_2:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I understand. Stay aboard the $$クォーター$$ for now, until things settle down.」

664:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ブレラ$$ sees his past self in the controlled $$バジュラ$$... $$レド$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$ feel their growth as they battle $$ストライカー#pilot$$...」

664:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In a battle spanning the galaxy, each person's feelings give birth to $$Ｚチップ$$s...」

664:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 100Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s born that way will surely become a power that saves us.」

664:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though this is hardly the time for such talk, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business!」

664:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our celebrations for ace pilots will have to wait until next time, but today I'll give it my all again... Business, business!」

664:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though this is hardly the time for such talk, we're open for business for now!」

664:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our celebrations for ace pilots will have to wait until next time, but today I'll give it my all again... Business, business!」

665:t_000:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「It looks like we've made it back to normal space, but...」

665:t_000:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Judging by our surroundings, we appear to be near the center of the galaxy.」

665:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is correct. We are approximately 1,000 light-years from the galaxy's center.」

665:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've also confirmed that all our ships, except $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, are safe within a 2,000-kilometer radius.」

665:t_000:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ is intact, too.」

665:t_000:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well, that's a relief for now.」

665:t_000:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, it is. At this distance, we can regroup with them quickly...」

665:t_000:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We should be able to reach the galaxy's center with a few hyperspace jumps.」

665:t_001:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The problem is attacks by the $$御使い$$s.」

665:t_001:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I never imagined they'd attack us in hyperspace.」

665:t_001:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「With their supernatural power, that level of attack is probably effortless for them.」

665:t_001:3.en:
$n
「So that is the power of a god...」

665:t_001:6.en:
$n
「So much has happened, and I still haven't sorted it all out, but this has made our situation simple.」

665:t_001:7.en:
$n
「The enemies we must defeat are called the $$御使い$$s... And $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was one of them... That's all there is to it.」

665:t_001:8.en:
$n
(Dad, Sis... and Mom... I'll do it, even if it costs me my life...)

665:t_001:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「No matter how powerful the $$御使い$$s are, $$スヴェル$$ protects Earth. All that's left is for us to take them down.」

665:t_001:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But we know far too little about the $$御使い$$s.」

665:t_001:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「They are higher-dimensional life-forms... They command $$サイデリアル$$ and oversee human evolution... They use $$次元力|lc$$ and can destroy even galaxies...」

665:t_001:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Judging by what $$ハーデス$$, $$ズール$$ and the others said, they oppose the self-proclaimed gods and seem to have power that surpasses even theirs.」

665:t_001:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Thanks to the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, we know the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest is at the galaxy's center, but we don't even know where those others are...」

665:t_001:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「But they know our every move. At this rate, they'll attack us and we won't be able to strike back.」

665:t_001:16.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Besides... Earth isn't guaranteed to be safe, either...」

665:t_001:17.en:
$$シン$$
「It'll be fine, $$セツコ$$. Earth has $$スヴェル$$ protecting it.」

665:t_001:18.en:
$$キラ$$
「But... if the galaxy itself disappears, I can't imagine Earth would be safe...」

665:t_001:19.en:
$$葵$$
「You're talking about that galaxy destruction they showed us...」

665:t_001:20.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I think... they did that to show us their power.」

665:t_001:21.en:
$$アポロ$$
「They destroyed an entire galaxy just for that?! Those bastards are insane.」

665:t_001:22.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If they used that power... on the galaxy we're in...」

665:t_001:23.en:
$$赤木$$
「No matter how powerful that $$スヴェル$$ thing is, it couldn't stop that...」

665:t_001:25.en:
$$トライア$$
「If they could use that kind of power, they'd have destroyed the galaxy... or at least Earth, long ago.」

665:t_001:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yet they haven't actually done so... We should take that as evidence that there's a reason they can't destroy the galaxy.」

665:t_001:27.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They said they were 'ready.' In other words, they probably aren't ready to destroy this galaxy or Earth.」

665:t_001:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「Since we don't know, there's no point dwelling on it. For now, we just need to keep moving toward the galaxy's center.」

665:t_001:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「Speaking of things we don't know, there is another.」

665:t_001:33.en:
$$シャア$$
「It is the existence of the $$時の牢獄$$.」

665:t_001:34.en:
$$アスラン$$
「You mean the thing that covered $$蒼の地球$$...」

665:t_001:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「Judging by $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s actions, I think the ones who created it were above $$サイデリアル$$... the $$御使い$$s, but...」

665:t_001:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「And $$ガドライト#pilot$$ said it was created to protect the people of Earth.」

665:t_001:37.en:
$$シャア$$
「Yet $$サイデリアル$$, which had conquered $$翠の地球$$, began its invasion of $$蒼の地球$$ when the $$時の牢獄$$ was broken.」

665:t_001:38.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「That is a contradiction... The $$御使い$$s made it to protect Earth's people, yet it hindered their invasion of Earth...」

665:t_001:39.en:
$$シン$$
「Do those bastards want to protect Earth's people or rule them?! Which is it?!」

665:t_001:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「Unfortunately, their intentions are unknown... Speculating here will not yield an answer.」

665:t_001:41.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I believe 'sorrow' is the key to resolving this contradiction.」

665:t_001:43.en:
$$シャア$$
「No. I mean the one remaining $$御使い$$.」

665:t_001:44.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You mean the last $$御使い$$...」

665:t_001:45.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Humans have four emotions: joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure... Since $$御使い$$s govern joy, anger, and pleasure, one must govern the remaining emotion, sorrow.」

665:t_001:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$御使い$$ who has yet to appear... must be the one who governs sorrow.」

665:t_001:47.en:
$$シャア$$
「I believe that individual holds the key to resolving the contradiction within the $$御使い$$s.」
